discovery_provenance.method: exploratory finite candidate search followed by complete deterministic enumeration

parent_formula.criticality_certificate: The full eight-clause parent is the unique clause subset of deficiency 2; every proper clause subset has deficiency at most 1.

siblings.branchwise_rank_effect: parent 2 -> siblings 1 and 1; both are SAT, both are strict descendants, and both remain nonterminal under the delta*=0 terminal gate

literal_substitution_exhaustion.definition: Each target variable maps to any signed source literal, repetitions allowed, with negation respected. Every target clause image must be tautological or contain a source clause as a subset.

meaning: R44BW previously showed relation non-universality but had one delta*=0 terminal child.
R44BY removes that escape: both siblings have positive rank 1 and require a genuine merge/safe-delete decision under R44BD V2.
No R44BS many-to-one signed-literal substitution exists in either direction, so this relation cannot universally discharge the active merge obligation.

next_exact_question: Move to one relation class strictly broader than many-to-one signed-literal substitution, but do not allow unrestricted constants because R44BX shows that all-constant certificates collapse discovery to ordinary SAT witness search.
